description: Full-service restaurant operator with Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, and other brands in the US and Canada.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-24 (Thursday, before the open), 5 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 2.05.
catalyst.why: Must show Olive Garden traffic and sales trends improving enough to support fiscal 2027 guidance reiteration.

reasons: Net income rose 32% and EPS rose from 2.98 to 3.66, yet the stock trades at 16.9x next-year earnings with all estimate revisions up.
Unlike BJRI and CAKE, which have rallied 44% and 70% on traffic improvements, DRI has not repriced despite early signs of improving Olive Garden traffic.
Darden's $1.5B buyback authorization and dividend increase shrink the share count and return cash, supporting EPS even if same-store sales stay flat.

quants.eps_revisions: all up, with 1 up and 0 down over last 30 days
extra: Last quarter net income increasing 32% quarter over quarter (5/31/2026)
Last quarter earnings before interest and tax increasing 30% quarter over quarter (5/31/2026)

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-24 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the thesis time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The credit ratio clears the floor, but the net debit is $3,330 and the short October calls cap upside if the stock runs through 220 before January. The 15.2% conservative credit is enough to justify the risk, but I'd want to see the report before adding size.
